content.body:
The list of missions for your brigade has important information to help you choose which mission to join. The Type column indicates if that mission is primarily infantry or armor with a symbol. The leaders of each mission are named, as are the origin and target of each mission, the strength level of that mission, the presence of squad members and mobile spawns.
Each mission is also color-coded (Attacking = Red, Defending = Green, Support = Blue).
content.title: Mission List
